# Bayes-Metaverse

***Tools, methods and resources for Bayesian meta-analysis.***

## What is Bayes-Metaverse?

Bayes-Metaverse brings together an R package suite, practical guidance
and links to established software to support a transparent, reproducible
workflow for Bayesian meta-analysis (Bayesian MA). The aim is to help
researchers move from a clearly specified review question through data
preparation, model fitting and checking, sensitivity analysis, and
interpretation.

The project is organised around a **workflow rather than a single
model**. Different reviews need different likelihoods, effect measures,
priors and sensitivity analyses; the workflow makes those choices
explicit and documents why they were made. See [Getting
Started](https://bayesian-metaverse.github.io/bayesmetaverse/articles/bayesmetaverse.html)
for the full workflow.

## Package suite

The packages are designed to work together while remaining useful as
standalone tools.

[![bayesmaDatR
hex](reference/figures/bayesmaDatR.png)](https://blmoran.github.io/bayesmaDatR/)

**bayesmaDatR** · Shiny app for structured data extraction and entry,
producing analysis-ready meta-analysis data

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-bayesmaDatR-1F6F8B?logo=github)](https://github.com/BLMoran/bayesmaDatR)
[![docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-bayesmaDatR-1F6F8B)](https://blmoran.github.io/bayesmaDatR/)
![experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)

[![inspectR
hex](reference/figures/inspectR.png)](https://github.com/BLMoran/inspectR)

**inspectR** · Assess and document study trustworthiness using the
INSPECT-SR framework

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-inspectR-1F6F8B?logo=github)](https://github.com/BLMoran/inspectR)
![experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)

[![robbR
hex](reference/figures/robbR.png)](https://blmoran.github.io/robbR/)

**robbR** · Create and present risk-of-bias visualisations

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-robbR-1F6F8B?logo=github)](https://github.com/BLMoran/robbR)
[![docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-robbR-1F6F8B)](https://blmoran.github.io/robbR/)
![experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)

[![bayesma
hex](reference/figures/bayesma.png)](https://blmoran.github.io/bayesma/)

**bayesma** · Fit, check, compare and interpret Bayesian meta-analysis
models using Stan

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-bayesma-1F6F8B?logo=github)](https://github.com/BLMoran/bayesma)
[![docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-bayesma-1F6F8B)](https://blmoran.github.io/bayesma/)
![experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)

[![bayesfoRest
hex](reference/figures/bayesfoRest.png)](https://blmoran.github.io/bayesfoRest/)

**bayesfoRest** · Forest plots and visualisations that bring posterior
results and study-level information together

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-bayesfoRest-1F6F8B?logo=github)](https://github.com/BLMoran/bayesfoRest)
[![docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-bayesfoRest-1F6F8B)](https://blmoran.github.io/bayesfoRest/)
![experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)

A package for **Bayesian sequential meta-analysis** (trial sequential
analysis), informed by Spence, Steinsaltz & Fanshawe (2016), is also in
development.

## Installation

Install the whole suite with the `bayesmetaverse` meta-package:

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("bayes-metaverse/bayesmetaverse")
```

Or install individual packages:

``` r

remotes::install_github("BLMoran/bayesmaDatR")
remotes::install_github("BLMoran/inspectR")
remotes::install_github("BLMoran/robbR")
remotes::install_github("BLMoran/bayesma")
remotes::install_github("BLMoran/bayesfoRest")
```

`bayesma` uses Stan via [cmdstanr](https://mc-stan.org/cmdstanr/). See
the [bayesma installation guide](https://blmoran.github.io/bayesma/) for
setting up CmdStan.

## Citation

If you use Bayes-Metaverse, please cite the packages you use and the
underlying methods:

``` r

citation("bayesmetaverse")
citation("bayesma")
```

``` bibtex
@Manual{bayesmetaverse,
  title  = {Bayes-Metaverse: Tools, Methods and Resources for Bayesian Meta-Analysis},
  author = {Benjamin Moran and Thomas Payne},
  year   = {2026},
  note   = {R package version 0.0.0.9000},
  url    = {https://github.com/bayesian-metaverse/bayesmetaverse},
}
```

## Feedback, issues and contribution

- **Bugs and feature requests:** open an issue in the relevant package
  repository, or in
  [bayesmetaverse](https://github.com/bayesian-metaverse/bayesmetaverse/issues)
  if you’re not sure which package.
- **Questions and ideas:** use [GitHub
  Discussions](https://github.com/bayesian-metaverse/bayesmetaverse/discussions).
- **Contributions:** pull requests are welcome. Please read the
  [contributing
  guide](https://bayesian-metaverse.github.io/bayesmetaverse/CONTRIBUTING.md)
  first.
- **Code of conduct:** this project follows a [Contributor Code of
  Conduct](https://bayesian-metaverse.github.io/bayesmetaverse/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
  By participating, you agree to abide by its terms.

  and the wider Stan ecosystem.
- The [INSPECT-SR](https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2024-082233) team, whose
  framework underpins inspectR.
- Spence, Steinsaltz & Fanshawe (2016) for the Bayesian sequential
  meta-analysis methods.
- The authors of [brms](https://paul-buerkner.github.io/brms/),
